article.headline: Scores from last Night: Southwind stays unbeaten with 83–48 win over Water Valley
article.html:
Water Valley’s boys basketball team lost 83–48 to Southwind in the Rumble On The Ridge on Thursday, November 26, as the Memphis program kept its unbeaten start intact.

Southwind is listed at 4–0 after the victory, while Water Valley is 1–5. The Jaguars preserved their perfect record with a comfortable final margin; the Blue Devils were unable to follow their previous victory with another win.

London Dyson scored 17 points for Southwind. MaxPreps’ matchup page also lists Dyson as the Jaguars’ Player of the Game.

Water Valley had beaten Houlka 74–41 on November 20. That remains the Blue Devils’ only listed victory through Thursday’s game. Their current schedule also records earlier losses to Winona, Rosa Fort, Independence and North Pontotoc, giving the Southwind result its place in a difficult opening stretch.

For background on the Blue Devils’ earlier basketball results, our previous varsity recap includes North Pontotoc’s sweep of Water Valley.
